deribit_instruments.expired_listing_note: The expired=true listing returns only the most recent batch of expired contracts (see distinct_expiry_dates for expired=true); it cannot reconstruct the historical expiry calendar, which is why the calendar is rule-constructed.

expiry_calendar.rule: last Friday of each calendar month, 08:00 UTC
expiry_calendar.source: Rule-constructed from the public Deribit rule; verified against listed expiries (calendar_verification) and the official Deribit Contract Introduction Policy. Not pulled from historical contracts: the public API returns only the most recent expired batch.
